title: Count Unique Characters of All Substrings of a Given String
summary: Define a function countUniqueChars(s) that calculates the number of distinct characters in string s.
statement: Define a function countUniqueChars(s) that calculates the number of distinct characters in string s. For instance, countUniqueChars("LEETCODE") equals 5 because 'L', 'T', 'C', 'O', 'D' are the only characters appearing once. Given a string s, compute the aggregate count of unique characters across all its substrings.
constraints: For every substring count characters occurring exactly once, then sum those counts modulo 1e9+7.
hints: An occurrence contributes to substrings whose left boundary follows its previous occurrence and right boundary precedes its next.
Finalize each occurrence when the next same character arrives, plus a sentinel finalization.
The two factors independently count legal left and right boundaries where that occurrence is unique.
editorial: The two factors independently count legal left and right boundaries where that occurrence is unique.

tests.explanation: The contributions are one, one, one, two, two, and one, totaling eight.
